study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting task-based fMRI activity using normative modelling: an application to the Emotional Face Matching Task

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study uses six datasets. HCP-YA, HCP-D, UK Biobank, and MIND-Set are mapped to the provided list. AOMIC PIOP2 and Duke Neurogenetics Study are also used but not in the standard list.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We collated a large reference sample from 6 independent sites for whom high quality fMRI data for the EFMT are available: AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult (1200 release), UK Biobank, and the MIND-Set cohort
